summary: The host selects a function pointer for width 2/4/8/16/32 from average row length and computes enough blocks for ceil(dim*width/blockSize) subgroups. Each subgroup is a row; its lanes walk the full CSR interval in GROUP_SIZE strides and reduce/store. Main warms once when dimension and iterations are nonzero, then starts timing and invokes the selected function exactly iterations times, with event completion and output copy after the loop. The compiled host function-pointer dispatch and all five actual launch helpers through cudaLaunchKernel were followed; every native sm86 width kernel was inspected through its row/CSR loops and store.
